The maximum size of this Control's bounding rectangle. If set to a value greater than or equal to [code](0, 0)[/code], the node's bounding rectangle will never exceed this size. A value below [code](0, 0)[/code] means there is no maximum size. This value has priority over [member custom_minimum_size] if the two conflict.

[b]Note:[/b] The final effective maximum size may be subject to the parent's maximum size (via [member propagate_maximum_size]), so it is recommended to use [method get_combined_maximum_size] instead of [method get_maximum_size]. Likewise, use [method get_bound_minimum_size] instead of [method get_combined_minimum_size] to account for the maximum size.

[b]Note:[/b] Not all [Control] subtypes handle this gracefully, and their contents may extend beyond the bounding rectangle. Set [member clip_contents] to [code]true[/code] to prevent child controls from rendering outside of this size, especially when this node is a [Container].
